claim_boundary: Finite exact directed-maze closure plus noisy empirical learning with known net-PnL ground truth. This is not live own-account execution and not a universal profitability theorem.

closure_reading.local_ball: The unresolved local operation neighborhood available to the AI token.
closure_reading.global_hair: A divergence-free authenticated closed value flow in ker(boundary).
closure_reading.natural_form: The finite vector of independent closed-hair profit curvatures; at full rank it determines every generated closed-flow profit.
closure_reading.profit_partition: Equality of the natural-form profit functional, not pointwise sameness of prices or costs.
closure_reading.unitary_potential_gate: A closed order is admitted only when all required independent hairs are currently certified, propagated profit LCB is positive, and closure confidence passes its floor.
closure_reading.empirical_freedom: The currently admitted subset of the closed-flow space. Knowledge can grow monotonically while this certified freedom expands, contracts, splits, or reorders after genuine curvature change.
closure_reading.negative_result: A genuine adversarial curvature shock can make a previously certified natural form stale. Immediate post-shock false positives occurred until authenticated interaction reopened and relearned the affected coordinates. Closure does not imply instantaneous universal adaptation.
